basis:
- Scope: TASK-090 at its task head 27fb3ff6. I read these myself:
  - the final contract r2 in full;
  - the unified diffs of launcher.py, writer.py, test_writer.py and test_launcher.py against the contract commit;
  - test_launcher_gone.py in full at fa324e53;
  - the fix diffs at 0fbde1ed (R26's insert helper) and at 27fb3ff6 (_gone_session's guard and the three test changes);
  - the outputs of the draft check, the local runs, the deterministic rule's local run, both broken-copy sets, and the three CI runs' logs;
  - both rounds of the way-2 review.
  I ran nothing myself.
- Architecture:
  - read_sessions is one read-only query constant and two private helpers. They are added by added lines only above the TASK-066 marker, in writer.py, the one module that opens the store.
  - start's step runs after the arguments and before the core's expiry, through five keyword callees with call-time defaults.
  - Each listed session reuses end's _path with no token, so it is skipped when any row is unexpired, whatever its task.
  - The record goes through read_set_record.observe_gone with the gone reason and a recorder holding the session id.
  - The removal comes only after end's own _present test.
  - Every outcome is a "gone_records: <id>: " line, put first by one keyword on _result. start's result keys are unchanged.
  - end, _path, _present, _conflict and _end_result are byte-equal to the base; _store_findings changes only its findings line.
  - DEF-0102's three findings places keep only a list's or a tuple's str items.
- Known limits accepted in decision D-2953:
  - a refused removal after a written record gives the record's line before the removal's findings, and no test pins that exact line;
  - a raise after observe_gone inside the session's guard is named by the call in progress.
- Evidence:
  - The CI run at the head passed every step, the bandit step included.
  - The first code commit's run failed only at bandit B608 on a test helper. It was fixed by bound parameters.
  - Twenty broken copies at the first commit and twenty at the head each fail a test of their own AC, and the unchanged copy passes.
- Verdict: no changes needed.
